note.item: Requires Joomla 5.4 or 6 and PHP 8.1 or later. Joomla 4 sites stay on 1.0.2.
Template overrides of the default layout must be updated: the layout now receives $links, $vertical, $position and $moduleclassSfx instead of $data, $verticalLayout and $alignItems.
Links with an icon but no text are shown without a link until text is added. After updating, a message lists the modules that need text.

addition.item: Links opening in a new window get rel="noopener noreferrer" and a note for screen readers.
Module class suffix is applied, and the list has a mod-prettylinks class.
Font Awesome is loaded through the Web Asset Manager when a link has an icon.
Field descriptions and a usage note in the module settings.

change.item: Link text is required and stays available to screen readers when it is hidden on mobile.
New links open in the same window by default.
Links are rendered as a list (ul/li) with gap spacing.
Rebuilt on the Joomla 5/6 module structure: service provider, Dispatcher and helper.

language.item: Dutch spelling fixes and one module description for the installer and the module editor.

security.item: Link text, URL and icon class are escaped on output (stored XSS).
Only relative, http, https, mailto and tel URLs are rendered as links; javascript: and other schemes are shown as text.

addition.item: Joomla 6 support in the update server.
